import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485747/attempts/18dbe85446804b4a9d8265837008f502/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v}
    top = min(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) for v in row if v)
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for c in colors:
        cells = [(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v == c]
        rmin = min(r for r,j in cells)
        for r,j in cells:
            nr = top + (r-rmin)
            out[nr][j] = c
    return out
'''
